preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two lines.
The first line contains integers n and k within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 100000 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n positive integers, each between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) if (a[i] * a[j]) ** (1/k) == int((a[i] * a[j]) ** (1/k)))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of pairs (i, j) with i < j such that the product a[i] * a[j] is a perfect k-th power.
